description: This file defines the KpiDecorator class, which acts as a decorator for the Kpi entity in the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for setting related JobTitle entities by ID and uses traits for ORM helper functions.

classes.name: KpiDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class for the Kpi entity, providing additional methods for manipulations related to JobTitle association.
